name: Bollywood Tandoori
kurzbeschreibung:
**Bollywood Tandoori in Garmisch-Partenkirchen**

Discover the vibrant flavors of India in the heart of the Alps! At **Bollywood Tandoori**, we bring the authentic taste of **Tandoori** cuisine to **Garmisch-Partenkirchen**, blending bold spices with the charm of **Bollywood**. Whether you crave smoky grilled meats, fragrant biryanis, or crispy samosas, our menu promises a culinary journey straight from the streets of Mumbai to the scenic beauty of the **Zugspitze**.

Indulge in our signature dishes like **Tandoori Chicken**, **Butter Chicken**, or **Lamb Rogan Josh**, all cooked in traditional clay ovens for that perfect smoky flavor. Pair your meal with a refreshing **Mango Lassi** or a spicy **Masala Chai**—because every bite deserves the right accompaniment.

After a day of skiing, hiking, or exploring the **Tirol**, treat yourself to a taste of India. **Bollywood Tandoori** is your gateway to exotic flavors in the midst of the Bavarian Alps. **Namaste & En Guete!**
